cues: And the microbes that work for us.
Lactobacillus turns milk sugar into lactic acid: curd.
Yeast makes bread rise and ferments raksi.
Aspergillus makes citric acid; a Streptococcus makes streptokinase to dissolve heart attack clots.
Rhizobium fixes nitrogen, Bacillus thuringiensis kills caterpillars, and methane making archaea run Nepal's biogas plants.
text: And the microbes that work for us. Lactobacillus turns milk sugar into lactic acid: curd. Yeast makes bread rise and ferments raksi. Aspergillus makes citric acid; a Streptococcus makes streptokinase to dissolve heart attack clots. Rhizobium fixes nitrogen, Bacillus thuringiensis kills caterpillars, and methane making archaea run Nepal's biogas plants.
